items.label: Copy of birth plan (if you have one)
Clothing for labor: loose and comfortable robe or gown, slip-on shoes
Toiletries (toothbrush, lip balm, hair ties, lotion, personal hygiene items, etc.)
Comfort items: blanket, pillow, playlist, speaker for music, white noise machine, personal fan
Re-usable water bottle with a straw
Going-home outfit (nursing bra, comfortable underwear, loose clothing)
Pediatrician information, if you have a specific person in mind (otherwise UCI will help you get your initial 2-3 day baby visit appointment at UCI)
Infant car seat (installed in the vehicle, no need to bring up to the room)
A few changes of clothes; PJs

hospitalProvides: Basic toiletries, witch hazel pads, lanolin cream
